ideas.title: AEVA: Physical AI portfolio up ~40% — fresh momentum signal
ideas.summary: An X-based Physical AI portfolio account flagged AEVA surging ~40% and BKSY up ~15% in early trading, citing broad strength in physical AI names. AEVA is noted as a larger position than Unity (U), which was sold at $28.4. No specific fundamental catalyst cited beyond portfolio momentum.

ideas.title: WOLF: Wolfspeed partners with LITEON on 800V silicon carbide data center power
ideas.summary: Wolfspeed and LITEON Technology announced a strategic partnership targeting 800VDC power sidecar and compute rack PSU platforms for data centers, leveraging Wolfspeed's 200mm silicon carbide manufacturing capacity. The collaboration positions WOLF's SiC technology as a key enabler for next-gen data center power infrastructure.

ideas.title: OUST: Personal trade anecdote — no actionable thesis
ideas.summary: A trader noted entering OUST around $23 following a post-Q1 selloff, but provided no fundamental thesis, price target, or catalyst. No actionable signal.

ideas.title: Winbond: Capex trimmed 2.5% amid EUV equipment crunch
ideas.summary: Winbond pared its 2026 capex to NT$39.5B (~$1.22B) from NT$40.5B previously, citing EUV lithography machine lead times that have stretched to 3–3.5 years. The cut reflects supply-side constraints on advanced equipment rather than demand weakness, with implications for EUV toolmakers' order visibility.

ideas.title: AEVA: X accounts flag +18% AH surge on CPO/NPO JDA announcement
ideas.summary: Aeva signed a Joint Development Agreement (undisclosed partner) and saw +18% after-hours gains, with the market noting its expansion into coherent/non-coherent photonics (CPO/NPO) optical sources beyond its core lidar business. SIVE is flagged as a high-confidence CW DFB laser supplier to Aeva in this new optical segment. The JDA represents a meaningful pivot for the company into datacom-adjacent photonics.

ideas.title: KLIC: Kulicke & Soffa Q2 call flags AI-driven back-end equipment cycle inflection
ideas.summary: Kulicke & Soffa's Q2 2026 earnings call surfaced strongly positive signals for the semiconductor back-end equipment cycle, with AI infrastructure demand cited as the key driver of global demand acceleration. This is a bullish read-through for KLIC as a picks-and-shovels play on AI silicon build-out.

ideas.title: TTMI: TTM Technologies Q2 confirms AI infrastructure demand in acceleration phase
ideas.summary: TTM Technologies' Q2 2026 earnings call highlighted that AI infrastructure demand remains in an acceleration phase across hyperscale compute and custom silicon, a positive read for PCB suppliers tied to the AI capex cycle.

ideas.title: VECO: Veeco Q3 EPS guidance misses consensus — bearish signal
ideas.summary: Veeco Instruments guided Q3 adjusted EPS to $0.35–$0.49 vs. the $0.52 consensus estimate, a meaningful miss. Diluted EPS guidance came in at $0.20–$0.34. The guidance shortfall is a negative read for the semiconductor equipment space.

ideas.title: SITM: SiTime Q2 beats on revenue and EPS amid AI infrastructure tailwinds
ideas.summary: SiTime reported Q2 revenue and EPS beats, with commentary tied to AI infrastructure trends. SITM is a precision timing semiconductor supplier that benefits from AI datacenter buildout demand.

ideas.title: GFS: Q3 guidance miss sends shares -5.8%; optical-networking demand still bullish signal
ideas.summary: GlobalFoundries guided Q3 net revenue to ~$1.89B, below expectations, sending shares down 5.8% premarket. However, the Q2 earnings call separately flagged that AI optical-networking demand is accelerating faster than available supply — a constructive read-through for the optical supply chain even as GFS itself stumbles on near-term guidance.

ideas.title: VPG: Vishay Precision Group crashes 35% intraday on FX headwinds
ideas.summary: Vishay Precision Group (VPG) fell as much as 35% intraday — its largest single-day drop — driven by FX headwinds weighing on results. The move flags significant fundamental deterioration for the precision sensors/test-systems name, a potential short setup or avoidance signal for the semiconductor-adjacent equipment space.

ideas.title: ZETA: CoffeeStocksGuy pitches long on double earnings beat
ideas.summary: Zeta Global (ZETA) drew bullish commentary after reporting a double beat, with the author noting an 'incredible reaction' and indicating a researched long position. ZETA is a marketing technology / data-driven ad platform — a non-universe tech name with apparent positive earnings momentum as a catalyst.

ideas.title: LSCC: 62% YoY revenue growth signals durable AI infrastructure cycle
ideas.summary: Lattice Semiconductor reported 62% year-over-year revenue growth in Q2 2026, with the earnings call flagging materially stronger signals about the breadth and duration of AI infrastructure spending. This suggests the AI capex buildout is broadening beyond hyperscalers into broader infrastructure layers where Lattice's FPGAs play.

ideas.title: DOCN: DigitalOcean Q2 read-through points to AI inference demand acceleration
ideas.summary: DigitalOcean's Q2 2026 earnings call highlighted accelerating AI inference demand, a potential positive read-through for smaller cloud/GPU-as-a-service providers targeting the SMB and developer market as hyperscaler capacity remains constrained.

ideas.title: ENTG: Entegris Q2 2026 earnings call flagged as potential read-through
ideas.summary: Entegris held its Q2 2026 earnings call during this window; as a key semiconductor materials/consumables supplier, results could provide signal on wafer fab activity and advanced packaging demand tied to the AI chip cycle.

ideas.title: ALMU: $30M equipment LOI signals China optics sector tailwind
ideas.summary: Almu signed a letter of intent for up to $30M in proposed equipment, flagged as a read-through from China optics sector news. The item notes broad sector impact across optical equipment names, with ALMU emerging as a direct beneficiary capturing new order flow.

ideas.title: DOCN: Shares -11% on Q2 revenue miss and weak Q3 margin guidance
ideas.summary: DigitalOcean fell 11% in premarket after Q2 revenue came in slightly below expectations and Q3 EBITDA margin growth guidance missed estimates. No specific pitcher named, but the Bloomberg report flags a fundamental guidance shortfall as the catalyst for the selloff.

ideas.title: ENTG: Q3 guidance beats consensus, flagged as positive read-through
ideas.summary: Entegris guided Q3 adjusted EPS above Bloomberg consensus estimates, representing a positive datapoint for the semiconductor materials/process chemicals name. No specific price target provided, but the beat-vs-consensus setup is flagged as a potential catalyst.

ideas.title: LWLG: X accounts flag optical transceiver ban as bullish for smaller optical players
ideas.summary: Following news that the Trump administration is drafting a ban on Chinese optical transceivers for US data centers, at least one X account flagged Lightwave Logic (LWLG) as a potential beneficiary given its electro-optic polymer modulator technology. The thesis is that Western alternative optical component suppliers — including smaller-cap names — stand to gain share as Innolight, Eoptolink and other Chinese vendors are locked out of US infrastructure builds.

ideas.title: ON: Key read-throughs from ON Semiconductor Q2 2026 earnings
ideas.summary: ON Semiconductor's Q2 2026 earnings call highlighted strong semiconductor capex cycle momentum, though no specific forward guidance details were extracted. The read-through is positive for the broader semi supply chain.

ideas.title: UCTT: Ultra Clean Holdings Q2 2026 shows semis capex strength
ideas.summary: Ultra Clean Holdings' Q2 2026 earnings call reflected continued momentum in the semiconductor capex cycle, with strong demand signals from equipment customers. No universe tickers were flagged as direct read-throughs.

ideas.title: STGW: Value investor Adam Wyden pitches long as company pivots to AI software platform
ideas.summary: Stagwell (STGW) raised full-year earnings guidance on record Q2 new business wins and is attempting a strategic shift from labor-intensive marketing services to an AI software platform model. Value investor Adam Wyden is publicly backing the name, though the author notes ad holding companies have historically struggled with such transitions.

ideas.title: OUST: X accounts pitch long on AMZN ownership catalyst and technical setup
ideas.summary: Multiple posts from @CoffeeStocksGuy and related accounts argue Ouster (OUST) is bullish given AMZN hitting an all-time high, with AMZN set to own ~5% of OUST post-vesting. Technical thesis is that a close above $40 opens a run toward $50.

ideas.title: FORM: Multiple accounts pitch strong beat-and-raise after Q2 earnings
ideas.summary: FormFactor (FORM) reported Q2 revenue of $258.2M vs. $240M consensus (+32% YoY) and adjusted EPS of $0.82 vs. $0.61 est. (3x YoY). Q3 guidance of $260M–$280M revenue and $0.77–$0.95 EPS both came in well above street expectations. Bullish commentary spans HBM, co-packaged optics (CPO), and the broader test equipment cycle.

ideas.title: SIMO: Silicon Motion flagged as earnings catalyst watch
ideas.summary: Silicon Motion (SIMO) provided Q3 revenue guidance per Bloomberg; the item was flagged as an interesting read-through for the NAND/storage controller space. No specific guidance figures were captured in the digest window, but the name was surfaced as noteworthy alongside the broader memory earnings cycle.

ideas.title: LRCX: Lam Research Q4 beat signals positive semi capex cycle
ideas.summary: Lam Research beat Q4 adjusted EPS estimates and commentary from the earnings call pointed to positive read-throughs for the broader semiconductor equipment capex cycle. LRCX is outside the JAT universe and was flagged as a potential beneficiary of continued WFE spending momentum.

ideas.title: APH: Amphenol Q2 shows AI infrastructure and data center momentum
ideas.summary: Amphenol's Q2 2026 earnings call highlighted positive momentum in AI infrastructure, data centers, and aerospace end markets. The read-through was flagged as constructive for the interconnect/connector space tied to AI buildout.

ideas.title: COHU: Flagged as next test equipment name to watch post-FORM beat
ideas.summary: Following strong results from FORM and prior outperformance in AEHR and TER, one X account flagged COHU as the next semi test equipment name likely to show earnings momentum. No specific price target was given, but the pattern in the test equipment subsector was cited as the setup.

ideas.title: GFS: X analyst pitches long on US Gov CHIPS Act stake + $300M award
ideas.summary: An X-based analyst notes the US Government is taking a 1% stake in GlobalFoundries (GFS) and awarding $300M under the CHIPS Act, specifically targeting CPO (co-packaged optics) and silicon photonics advancement. The analyst expresses surprise the stock remains down despite this government support, drawing a parallel to INTC as a precedent for US Gov backing of foundry players. Thesis: government-backed compute supply chain priority makes GFS a critical minerals/advanced packaging play amid China competition.

ideas.title: FLEX: Q1 FY2027 earnings signal AI infrastructure cycle broadening
ideas.summary: Flex's Q1 FY2027 earnings call highlighted that AI infrastructure investment is expanding beyond accelerators and servers into power conversion and electrical distribution. This is flagged as a key read-through for the broader AI infrastructure supply chain.

ideas.title: TER: Crushed Q1 with $1.33B revenue (2x YoY); Q3 guide well ahead of consensus
ideas.summary: Teradyne reported $1.33B in revenue, more than doubling year-over-year, with Q3 guidance coming in well ahead of consensus. The strong print is flagged as a potential positive read-through for COHU, which reports the following day.

ideas.title: GFS: LoI on optical data-interconnect technology surfaces as potential catalyst
ideas.summary: An item flagged $GFS (GlobalFoundries) in relation to a Letter of Intent centered on optical technology for high-speed data movement. No further financial details or pitcher identity were provided, but the LoI framing suggests a potential partnership or licensing catalyst worth monitoring.

ideas.title: SKHY: Analyst maintains +150% PT; headline miss attributed to HBM mix, not cycle weakness
ideas.summary: SK Hynix reported Q2 revenue of $54.6B (vs. $57.7B estimate) and operating profit of 60.54T won (vs. 64.22T won estimate), but net income of 93.82T won beat the 54.32T won estimate handily. One analyst characterized the miss as overblown, attributing it to SK's HBM-heavy product mix rather than any supercycle break, and maintained a +150% price target; stock recovered ~5.5% after-hours. The earnings call also flagged AI memory broadening beyond HBM into conventional server DRAM, enterprise SSDs, and advanced packaging.

ideas.title: KLAC: Beat on Q4 revenue with key read-throughs for semis
ideas.summary: KLA Corp beat Q4 2026 revenue estimates per Bloomberg, and a detailed earnings call read-through was published. As a wafer inspection/process control leader, KLAC results are a positive read-through for semi cap equipment cycle durability.

ideas.title: TER: Teradyne posts 104% YoY revenue growth, 300%+ EPS growth
ideas.summary: Teradyne reported blowout Q2 results with 104% YoY revenue growth and over 300% EPS growth, with Q3 adjusted EPS guidance issued. One author views the post-print selloff as extreme short-term deleveraging that overshot individual stock fundamentals.

ideas.title: OUST: X accounts highlight clean balance sheet and strengthening macro bull case
ideas.summary: Two separate posts flagged Ouster ($OUST) — one citing one of the "cleanest balance sheet transformations" in its category, and another noting a strengthening macro bull case tied to the Chinese robotics ban. No formal price target or analyst firm was cited.

ideas.title: Domestic robotics names: Trump/FCC Chinese robot ban seen as US beneficiary catalyst
ideas.summary: Reuters reported the FCC is set to ban Chinese imports of humanoid and quadruped robots to protect American robotics programs, and separately Trump announced a complete ban on Chinese robots. Multiple sources flagged this as a catalyst for domestic US humanoid/robotics companies, though no specific non-universe beneficiary ticker was named with a formal pitch.

ideas.title: SVCO: PhotonCap pitches AI/digital twin integration play
ideas.summary: Silvaco Group (SVCO) is integrating NVIDIA accelerated computing and AI into its physics-based simulation portfolio to advance digital twin capabilities. The pitch frames SVCO as a derivative AI infrastructure beneficiary via simulation software.

ideas.title: ASML: BofA argues China position not under threat
ideas.summary: Bank of America contends that ASML's market position in China is not under immediate threat despite ongoing geopolitical tensions, citing the difficulty of replicating ASML's technological capabilities and established footprint. No price target was cited in the post.

ideas.title: SKHY: X account flags deep value at ~4.5x FY2027E EPS
ideas.summary: At sub-$145, SKHY is trading near 4.5x FY2027 EPS and 4.2x FY2028 EPS, per an X account pitch. No additional fundamental detail was provided beyond the valuation framing.

ideas.title: SONY: X account pitches bull case on image sensor monopoly + GTA VI/physical AI catalysts
ideas.summary: An X account is bullish on Sony, citing its position as the world's #1 image sensor maker and two emerging growth vectors: the GTA VI release cycle and physical AI sensing demand. The author notes the market is beginning to recognize these catalysts, with the thesis 'going brr.'

ideas.title: ADI: Cyclical recovery + AI infrastructure surge thesis pitched by multiple accounts
ideas.summary: Analog Devices was pitched as a cyclical recovery and AI infrastructure beneficiary, with at least two accounts referencing a detailed write-up and a thesis from MD Sass. The AI-generated analysis was touted as particularly strong, though specific price targets were not disclosed in the available content.

ideas.title: OUST: Author adds shares, bullish on lidar as core of physical AI
ideas.summary: The author added to an OUST position, arguing lidar is becoming central to physical AI applications across automotive, robotics, and smart infrastructure. A recently launched leveraged ETF was noted as amplifying short-term volatility but the long-term thesis was described as intact.

ideas.title: MXL: Bullish read-through on AI data-center connectivity post Q2 2026 earnings
ideas.summary: MaxLinear's Q2 2026 earnings call was flagged as materially positive for AI data-center connectivity, with 800G optical DSPs showing strong momentum and 1.6T optical development underway. Market cap sits around $6.5B with next-quarter guidance of ~$215M (+27.4% QoQ). High-speed analog front-end demand was also cited as strong, making MXL a potential derivative play on AI infrastructure buildout.

ideas.title: MXL: Strong Q2 beat — 55% YoY revenue growth worth watching
ideas.summary: MaxLinear (MXL) reported Q2 revenue of $168.8M, up 55% YoY and 23% sequentially, flagged by an X account as an impressive quarter. No explicit PT given, but the commentary frames this as a standout growth print in the connectivity/semiconductor space.

ideas.title: AMKR: Nvidia signs $1.5B packaging deal, bullish read-through
ideas.summary: Nvidia signed a $1.5 billion agreement with Amkor Technology, including a prepayment component, to expand semiconductor packaging capacity in the US. The deal is a direct revenue catalyst for AMKR and validates its role as a key packaging partner in Nvidia's domestic supply chain buildout.

ideas.title: NVEC: AsymmetricB pitches long — stock up 52% post-earnings
ideas.summary: NVEC (NVE Corporation) surged 52% on the day following what the account @AsymmetricB characterized as a strong earnings beat. No specific price target or detailed thesis was provided beyond highlighting the earnings-driven catalyst.

ideas.title: OUST: Highlighted as notable setup at ~$2.56B market cap
ideas.summary: OUST (Ouster) was flagged with a market cap of approximately $2.56B following recent price action described as an eventful journey. No explicit directional thesis or price target was provided in the source.

ideas.title: INFQ: Three DOE Genesis Mission awards seen as potential catalyst
ideas.summary: INFQ landed three Department of Energy Genesis Mission awards, with the author flagging a specific number as key to the investment case. No price target or detailed bull/bear framing was provided beyond the contract win catalyst.

ideas.title: OUST: X account pitches long on broad customer diversification
ideas.summary: The account highlights Ouster's thousands of global customers across four primary verticals as a core bull thesis, suggesting the diversified revenue base is underappreciated by investors who dismiss lidar names at surface level. No specific price target was provided, but the pitch frames OUST's commercial breadth as a key differentiator.
